name: BACH_0200
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (89%)** · Confident · Read in turn

A single-class conformal set, second-model agreement and 5/5 similar cases support in situ [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 89%, Invasive 11% | Clear leader |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / percentile 1.0 | No input warning |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 5/5 InSitu | Neighbors agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 1, 4) · ↑ invasive · Associated with invasion, against the in situ suggestion [F3] · Validated
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 1, 4, 9) · context · 74% neoplastic nuclei, above 97% of reference images [F7] · Measured
- **Nuclear size** (regions 1, 4, 9) · context · Mean area lowest in reference; size variation high [F8] · Measured
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 2, 3, 7) · context · Score above typical; not sampled by cell counts [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 7, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Score high but failed spot check, 3/20 [F4] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion difference +0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier; necrosis (3/20) unreliable, lymphocytes (8/20) weak.

## Could be wrong if
- Regions 0, 1, 9 score 94%, 72%, 86% invasive per region, yet image-level invasive is 11%.
- Cell measurements cover only regions 1, 4, 9; remaining regions are unsampled.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 4** — Check whether tumor cells extend into stroma beyond ducts.
2. **Regions 0, 9** — Highest per-region invasive scores; confirm in situ versus invasive.
3. **Regions 7, 10, 11** — Confirm whether necrosis is truly present; the score failed its spot check.
